correctness.rationale: The finite graph is given by a 16-cycle plus eight chords and is cubic bipartite. Exact formulas for its two 8-bit majority maps yield \(F^5=F^3\) on all \(2^{16}\) configurations; a state with first-entry time three establishes sharpness. Complete 256-word finite tables show 12 rotation classes comprising 72 stable symbols, with preimage weights 1 (22), 2 (48), 69 (2); the recurrent swap bijection then proves 72 fixed states, 2556 two-cycles, and the nine row basin census using w(s)^2 and 2w(s)w(t). Two independent standard-library programs were executed from current package paths. verify_full.py independently checks every one of 65536 graph configurations, all basin sizes and entry times; outputs are included. No sampled-to-infinite extrapolation.

originality.rationale: The Heawood majority incidence result is a structurally close analogue on a different graph: its 58 symbols and idempotent shore projection do not imply the 72-symbol Möbius–Kantor retraction or its 88-to-72 intermediate collapse. The Pappus graph has another 92-symbol census; not the same graph. Benjamini et al. and the Goles–Olivos theorem guarantee eventual periods <=2, but not the exact 16-vertex basin spectrum or clock. Specific searches under \(GP(8,3)\), graph aliases, majority-vote, recurrent symbols, 72, 2556, and basins found no exact match. Priority remains qualified due to unindexed literature and one inaccessible historical original.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural invariant of the unique cubic symmetric 16-vertex graph, not an arbitrary selected graph: a canonical 12-necklace classification yields six distinct primitive oscillator basin sizes and three structural source-fiber weights. The 88-to-72 secondary collapse produces a genuine sharp transient delay versus the Fano-incidence model. The 231 dynamically isolated primitive oscillations and unique 9522-configuration oscillation basin provide useful exact benchmarks for stability and accessibility on symmetric networks. The fact is finite and self-contained; no unsupported broad theorem or applied impact is claimed.
